column1: # The pinned SPIR-V producer the E5-S shader pack is compiled by, and the one
# authority that states it. fetch-shaderc-toolchain.sh reads this file and
# refuses a row it cannot verify against; build-spirv-shader-pack.sh records the
# executed compiler's own version string and digest beside the pack, so a pack
# built by another toolchain is visible after the fact rather than trusted.
# The appliance's distribution shaderc rejects GL_EXT_integer_dot_product
# (evidence/web-admission-router-tools/build-raven2-vulkan-production.log:33),
# which is a gate in the SPIR-V producer rather than in the driver, so E5-S0 and
# E5-S1 need a producer that emits OpSDot and the driver on the appliance
# consumes what this one wrote.
# v2026.3 is the tag whose glslc reproduces the module every retained E5-S0 and
# E5-S1 receipt names: `mul_mat_vecq.comp` at llama.cpp f280b269 under the
# pinned defines and `-O` compiles to sha256 2659f04ce6... at 36940 bytes, the
# spirv_sha256 and spirv_bytes both receipts record. archive_sha256 is measured
# over the download rather than recalled, and the digest pins the shaderc
# archive alone: utils/git-sync-deps resolves glslang, SPIRV-Tools, and
# SPIRV-Headers from that revision's own DEPS at fetch time, so the built
# compiler's identity is what pack-inputs.tsv records after the fact.
# prefix is one plain directory component under the fetcher's PREFIX_ROOT, and
# it names the revision so two pins install beside each other rather than one
# building over a toolchain a retained pack record names.
